summary: Tested RC-002-CRIT-GEMINI-001 section 4's mechanism claim (the sweep candle's push to the extreme creates the opposing trend_bias) against a pre-existing-trend alternative, by measuring opposition at lags t, t-1, t-2, t-3 over all 203 sweep-firing bars. Result 89.66 / 83.25 / 77.83 / 68.47 percent. SUPPORTED BUT NOT COMPLETE: the monotone +21pp gradient into the event matches the EMA-pull mechanism, but 68.47 percent opposition already three bars out is far above the 50 percent a purely event-created effect implies. The two cannot be cleanly separated at these lags because the approach to a range extreme itself spans several bars. Section 4's conclusion stands and is strengthened: the 89.66 percent rate is structurally determined by the interaction of the two constructions, not an independent finding.
falsifier: If opposition at t-3 had been near 50 percent, the EMA-pull mechanism would be the complete explanation; if it had been ~90 percent flat across all lags, the mechanism would be refuted outright.
h1_h2_h3_risks: H1: reading a lag gradient as a clean causal separation

summary: Executed the frozen pre-registration on the Phase-1 ADMITTED corpus (data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv, sha 4d73f5ce..., 47275 bars). n_violating=553, n_continuation=1100, both far above the declared floor of 150 -> not INSUFFICIENT. PRIMARY (close beyond the swept extreme, Referent A = HTF range bound): VIOLATING 0.8047 vs CONTROL 0.3891, diff +0.4156, block-bootstrap CI (+0.3681,+0.4621), does NOT cross zero. S2 extend/RefA +0.4887 also non-null. S3 duration -0.34 bars, non-null but substantively negligible (1.54 vs 1.88, metric saturated). Referent disagreement only 5.79% (32/553) and the primary verdict does NOT flip. Effective blocks 307/366 vs raw 553/1100. FIRST NON-NULL RESULT on this population in the entire programme. TWO DEFECTS FOUND POST-HOC AND DECLARED, NOT REPAIRED: (a) S1 is INVALID by construction - its control asks whether a bar's close exceeds its own high, which is impossible, so p_control identically 0; (b) the PRIMARY control is NOT matched on proximity - VIOLATING bars sit in SWEEP state having just probed the very bound under test, so the gap cannot yet separate a real break-through effect from a proximity selection effect. Neither repaired inside RC-003: section 8 forbids fishing a new test from the results. KILL MAP: nothing dies. SAME_SIDE_CONTINUATION_THROUGH_SWEEP does not die (it is now the leading hypothesis, well powered and openly confounded); NOT_A_DISTINCT_OBJECT and INDEPENDENT_IMPULSE_WITH_LIVE_SWEEP do NOT die because the second clause of the kill map ('continuation bars leave the OTHER side') was not measured; MISPARENTED_DISPLACEMENT was out of scope by design. Semantic identity remains UNKNOWN. Frozen prediction 1 (expects to be unable to reject NOT_A_DISTINCT_OBJECT) was WRONG; prediction 2 weaker than predicted; prediction 3 confirmed.
falsifier: A proximity-matched control - bars equidistant from the same range bound, in the same state, that did NOT fail the directional contract - would separate the real effect from the selection effect. That is a new pre-registration, not a re-cut.
